### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing.
*Example: As an autonomous procurement agent, I need a verifiable receipt format for multi-party invoice settlement.*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.
*Describe the feature, architecture impact, or new protocol support (e.g., OPA policy extension, new payment rail, ledger adapter).*

### Alternative Solutions or Workarounds
A description of any alternative solutions, designs, or workarounds you've considered.

- [ ] Agent Kernel / Policy Engine

- [ ] UI / Simulation Dashboard

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, protocol specifications, or references here.
